images.caption: Figure 2:Search-Native Pretraining pipeline overview.(1)We augment training documents with inline search queries and corresponding search results, intended to contain useful knowledge for predicting original document continuation.(2)We train on(1), computing loss only on original document tokens and search queries (green), while search results are masked (gray).(3)During inference, QueryLMgenerates search queries to retrieve relevant information from an external knowledge base.
